messages:
Maria (Marketing): Heads up — noticed ~120 leads ended up unassigned between 00:00-04:00 UTC this morning. HubSpot shows the enrichment step 'company_lookup' timing out and the round-robin claim never fired. Chart: https://dash.redwood.com/leads/enrich?range=4h

Lina (RevOps): On it. Do we have workflow failure logs? I suspect the enrichment webhook retries suppressed the CLAIM event.

workflow-bot: Workflow failed for workflow_id=hs_enrich_v3, step=company_lookup, status=503, retries=3, batch_id=enc_20240405_03. Logs: https://logs.redwood.com/workflows/enc_20240405_03

Ben (Sales): Seeing the same spike in EMEA — queues showed empty so SDRs had nothing to claim. Can we fallback to a default owner after N enrichment retries?

Ashok (Eng): Quick thought: we could emit a CLAIM event even when enrichment is pending, tagging the lead with 'enrich_pending' so SDRs can take ownership and enrichment can populate fields asynchronously. Need to ensure we don't double-claim when enrichment later triggers a normal assign.

Samir (Ops): I sketched a query to find stuck leads so we can sample and confirm state:
```sql
SELECT id, created_at, enrichment_state, owner_id FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
  AND owner_id IS NULL
  AND enrichment_state IN ('failed','pending');
```

Maria (Marketing): Love it. Lina, can you run that and paste a few sample IDs? Ben, do we want the fallback behavior (assign_default_owner) after 2 failed enrichment attempts? Proposing SLA: if enrichment retries >=2 within 15 minutes -> fallback assign.

Lina (RevOps): Running the query now, will post 10 sample IDs in a sec. Also pinging HubSpot integrations team — looks like webhook throttle spikes at ~3:10 UTC. cc @Ashok for patch window.

Ashok (Eng): I can ship a small config change to the round-robin to include a 15-minute fallback path that ignores enrichment_pending. Will coordinate with releases for a low-risk rollout. ETA ~2 hours.

Ben (Sales): :thumbsup: Please also add a PagerDuty alert if fallback assignment rate > 5% over a 30-minute window so Sales Ops can react. They want visibility before we flip anything permanent.

Samir (Ops): I will update the RR config to treat leads with tag 'enrich_pending' as assignable and add a safe-guard to avoid duplicate assignments. Also adding a short backfill job to claim the currently unowned sample set.

Maria (Marketing): Action items summary: 1) Lina run query + post sample IDs and confirm webhook throttle with HubSpot; 2) Ashok deploy 15-min fallback config to round-robin; 3) Samir update RR logic + run backfill for current stuck leads; 4) Ben add PagerDuty alert and dashboard panel for fallback rate; 5) I'll update the inbound playbook and notify SDR leads. Thanks team :rocket:

Lina (RevOps): Posted sample IDs and CSV in #marketing-ops: https://files.redwood.com/samples/unassigned_leads_1712349999.csv — a quick look shows company_lookup error_code=504 for many.

workflow-bot: Deployment scheduled: rr-fallback-config v1.1 -> canary @ 1712360000 (watch metrics).

Ashok (Eng): Will monitor canary and rollback if claim duplication > 0.1%.

Ben (Sales): Appreciate the fast turnaround. Keep me posted and I'll message SDR leads if we enable the fallback.

Maria (Marketing): Thanks all — will follow up in the playbook doc and loop back when canary looks stable.
